strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with elementwise fusion
strategies.desc: Perform 8 sequential all-reduce operations with all local elementwise operations (scaling, unscaling, division by W) fused between all-reduces. 8 all-reduce dispatches total. Minimizes dispatch count by fusing all local ops, trading off no overlapping of communication with computation.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather pipeline
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, enabling 16 total collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG pairs). Each rank only computes scaling operations on its owned shard between RS and AG, reducing local compute by factor of W. Trades more dispatches for dramatically less elementwise work per stage.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction stages
strategies.desc: Exploit potential multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions followed by inter-node reductions at each of the 8 stages, using 16 all-reduce dispatches on smaller communicator groups. Reduces per-dispatch latency and bandwidth pressure on inter-node links, but increases total dispatch count.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapped computation-communication
strategies.desc: Split the vector into independent chunks and pipeline all-reduce operations on different chunks while performing local scaling operations on already-reduced chunks. Uses ~8 all-reduce dispatches with chunked payloads, overlapping communication of chunk i with computation on chunk i-1. Hides local op latency behind network transfers.

strategies.name: Pre-computed coefficient batch accumulation
strategies.desc:
Recognize that scaling coefficients form a pattern (a[r] values cycle mod 4) and restructure computation to accumulate partial results for each coefficient class, then perform fewer all-reduces on pre-scaled chunks. Reduces from 8 to potentially 4-5 all-reduce dispatches by batching stages with algebraic simplification of scale/unscale chains.
